messages:
pat: Quick sync — console invoice-preview jumped for route=preview-pro when we rolled pricing update at 06:00. small set of tenants show list_price instead of promo. Anyone else?

neha: running narrow query: `SELECT tenant_id, sum(tokens) FROM ingest.raw WHERE route='preview-pro' AND ts >= '2026-03-15T06:00:00Z' AND route_hint IS NULL GROUP BY tenant_id` — seeing nontrivial token volume.

owen: fetched samples from kafka: `kcat -C -b kafka:9092 -t ingress-raw -o -500 | jq -c 'select(.route=="preview-pro")'` — retry events often have headers object missing `route_hint`.

infra-bot: deploy: edge-proxy v3.3.2 canary started 05:57 UTC, progressed 06:04 UTC.

pat: hypothesis — retry path lost custom headers. That would explain previews showing full price.

neha: remediation options: 1) rollback canary; 2) ingest enrichment backfill when route_hint is null and retry_count>0; 3) accept correction later.

owen: prefer enrichment + limited replay. Keep production churn low. Enrichment rules: only for preview-pro, add `X-Route-Hint-Backfilled:true`, emit metric `ingest.enrich.preview_pro.backfilled`, write to compacted tombstone topic to avoid double-apply.

billing-bot: Finance request: provide affected_token_sum and USD delta before any retroactive invoice adjustments.

neha: running a quick aggregate, preliminary affected_tokens ~ 850k tokens in the last 12h; estimated delta ~$85. I'll post exact numbers in 30m.

pat: console UX: add "pricing-source" column (header, enriched, unknown) and a small 'confidence' tooltip so CS isn't surprised by post-backfill invoice edits.

owen: I'll add a smoke e2e that issues a retried request and asserts `route_hint` persists; will open PR to routing-tests.

infra-bot: created incident INC-5033 to track decision. Plan: canary enrichment to one consumer instance for 10m, monitor `consumer.lag` and backfill metric, then small replay 1h window if green.

neha: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infer/ingest/pull/499 — includes enrichment, tombstone, metrics. starting canary in 20m.

pat: thanks — tag billing with exact numbers before replay. Keep updates here.
